items.title: Google AI Overviews Reduce Search Clicks by 42%, New Report Reveals
items.summary: A recent report shows that Google's AI Overviews have caused a 42% reduction in clicks from search results. This trend underscores the rise of zero-click searches powered by AI summaries. SEO professionals must pivot strategies to maintain visibility and traffic in this changing landscape.

items.title: Google Discover Core Update Causes Reach Loss for Local Publishers
items.summary: New data from the Google Discover Core Update reveals substantial declines in reach for local publishers. This update impacts content distribution in personalized Discover feeds. Publishers are urged to review performance metrics and refine content to recover visibility.

items.title: Surface-Level SEO Tactics Insufficient for AI Search Visibility
items.summary: Industry experts emphasize that basic SEO techniques fall short for achieving lasting presence in AI-driven search. Comprehensive approaches emphasizing authority, unique insights, and AI-friendly structures are necessary. This evolution demands a rethink of traditional optimization practices.

items.title: Open-Source geo-seo-claude Tool Optimizes Sites for AI Search Engines
items.summary: The geo-seo-claude tool, now open-source, enables full GEO audits for AI engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity using parallel subagents. It assesses structured data for LLMs and produces detailed PDF reports in seconds. This marks a significant advancement in Generative Engine Optimization accessibility.

items.title: Ahrefs Firehose: New Real-Time API Transforms SEO Monitoring
items.summary: Ahrefs unveiled Firehose, a real-time web monitoring API tailored for SEO tasks like competitor tracking and link prospecting. It supports Lucene queries for detecting content changes, brand mentions, and more. An accompanying playbook offers Python scripts for automated daily SEO insights.

items.title: From SEO to AEO to GEO: Decoding Search Optimization Evolutions
items.summary: SEO veteran Josh Nay outlines the progression from traditional SEO (rankings via keywords and links) to AEO (direct answers for voice/AI) and GEO (citations in generative summaries). He advises brands to pursue all three parallelly amid AI search dominance. This post highlights adaptive strategies for modern visibility.

items.title: Grammarly Removes AI 'Expert Review' Feature After Backlash for Mimicking Writers
items.summary: Grammarly has discontinued its AI Expert Review feature that generated editing suggestions styled after well-known authors and academics, following widespread criticism. The tool was accused of impersonating experts without permission, sparking outrage among journalists and writers. This decision comes amid growing lawsuits alleging misuse of names and reputations.

items.title: Self-Publishing Scams Boom as Fraudsters Use AI to Target Authors
items.summary: A Guardian interactive story details how scammers are leveraging AI to perpetrate fraud in self-publishing, exemplified by author Jon's devastating experience. Fraudsters supercharge swindles promising publishing dreams but delivering heartbreak. The piece highlights the rising threat in the indie publishing landscape.

items.title: Media Control and NielsenIQ Launch Official UK BookTok Charts for Publishers
items.summary: Media Control and NielsenIQ BookData are introducing BookTok Charts to track TikTok-driven book trends in the UK. The charts provide analytical data to help publishers identify emerging influences on genres and titles. This tool aims to guide acquisition and marketing decisions based on social media buzz.

items.title: Tech Journalist Slams Grammarly for Impersonating Him in AI Editing Tool
items.summary: Ray Wong accuses Grammarly's Expert Review AI of identity theft by using his name, handle, and past articles to suggest edits as if from him. He calls out the inadequate disclaimer and questions the ethics of scraping careers for AI output. The post ignited significant discussion on AI misuse in writing tools.

items.title: Author Betrayed as Editor Feeds Manuscript to ChatGPT for Edit Letter
items.summary: Fantasy author Autumn Bauman reveals an editor used ChatGPT on her full manuscript to generate the entire edit letter, breaching trust. She also lost over $100 in design work to Claude AI. The incident fuels her hatred toward AI encroachment in creative editing.

items.title: Publishers Captured by Ideology Now Rely on BookTok Indie Hits to Survive
items.summary: Publishers, ideologically focused on progressive titles that sell poorly, depend on TikTok indie books with popular tropes to stay afloat. Self-published authors achieve seven-figure success before trad deals, forcing acquisitions. The post laments the shift away from soul-nourishing storytelling toward fast-moving market demands.

items.title: Michael B. Jordan Wins Best Actor for 'Sinners' at 2026 Oscars
items.summary: Michael B. Jordan secured the Best Actor Oscar for his performance in 'Sinners' at the 98th Academy Awards, earning a standing ovation. The ceremony, hosted by Conan O'Brien, highlighted wins for films like 'Sinners' and 'One Battle After Another'. Avengers stars including Robert Downey Jr. presented an award.

items.title: Timothée Chalamet Sparks Backlash Over Ballet and Opera Comments
items.summary: Timothée Chalamet drew criticism after stating 'no one cares' about ballet and opera in an interview. Performers, his former principal, and celebrities like Whoopi Goldberg reacted negatively. Conan O'Brien referenced the controversy while roasting him at the Oscars.

items.title: Gene Simmons Faces Backlash for Telling Celebrities to 'Shut Up' on Politics
items.summary: KISS co-founder Gene Simmons criticized celebrities for sharing political views, saying they should 'shut their pie holes' and focus on art. He argued entertainers in luxury shouldn't lecture working people. The remarks ignited online debate.

items.title: Viral Clip of Gene Simmons Telling Celebs to 'Shut the F*** Up' About Politics
items.summary: A video of Gene Simmons blasting celebrities like Ben Stiller and Mark Ruffalo for political lecturing went viral with over 200k likes. He emphasized doing art instead of opining from mansions. The post amplified audience frustration with celebrity activism.

items.title: Timothée Chalamet Controversy: 'No One Cares' About Ballet and Opera
items.summary: NME post highlights backlash to Timothée Chalamet's dismissal of ballet and opera, with critics calling it a cheap shot at artists. The statement received over 1k likes and numerous replies. Discussion continued leading into Oscars.

items.title: Rachel Zegler Reflects on 'Confusing' Snow White Backlash
items.summary: Rachel Zegler addressed backlash to her casting in Disney's Snow White remake, calling it confusing due to her heritage. She stated she refuses to assimilate for others' comfort. The reflection ties into the film's reported financial loss amid audience reaction.

items.title: Hill Top Contractors Leverages Google NotebookLM for Small Business Efficiency
items.summary: CEO John Stumps at Hill Top Contractors in Roanoke, Virginia, is using Google's NotebookLM AI to transform massive historic documents into actionable timelines for storage tank and petroleum remediation services. This AI tool enables the small business to make a significant impact by streamlining complex data processing. It highlights practical AI applications boosting productivity for SMBs.

items.title: Small Business Owners Build Custom AI Tools to Cut Costs and Boost Efficiency
items.summary: Small business owners are creating practical AI solutions like an AI receptionist for dentists saving $4k/month, demand prediction for food trucks reducing waste by 40%, and AI photo editors for photographers doubling bookings. These non-coders demonstrate how AI tools directly impact operations and competitiveness. The examples underscore the growing gap between AI adopters and those waiting.

items.title: Why LinkedIn Created an All-In-One AI Tool for Small Businesses
items.summary: LinkedIn's Premium All-In-One is an AI-driven tool designed for small businesses, offering a unified dashboard to streamline finding clients, marketing services, and hiring staff. It uses AI to write messages, craft social media posts, suggest prospects in desired industries and locations, and provide daily recommendations, saving users five to seven hours a week. This platform democratizes advanced efficiency tools previously reserved for larger enterprises.
items.source: CO— by U.S. Chamber of Commerce

items.title: Rowan Launches AI-Powered Platform to Tackle Small Business Succession Crisis
items.summary: Rowan has introduced an AI-powered platform that organizes clean, buyer-ready financial and operational data for small businesses facing succession challenges. This tool addresses key pain points in business transitions by automating data preparation. It enables SMB owners to prepare effectively for sales or handovers, enhancing value and marketability.
